title: Selecting 'ask Mirren: take the company's gold to keep it quiet' at the company store gave no warning it would do anything beyond a bribe, but it permanently and irreversibly removed Tamsin from the party ('Tamsin leaves your company') and closed her personal quest as failed. Other risky choices in the game are explicitly flagged ('a miss costs standing'); this one wasn't flagged at all.
where: Cinderhall / The Company Store, action 'ask Mirren: take the company's gold to keep it quiet'
